cases, plus an inspected comparator for criterion 3. Missing authority vetoes
only affected claims/comparisons; invalid accounting inputs, corrupted source
hashes or failed arithmetic/replay veto engineering acceptance. Access blocks
are not a continuation veto for independent repairs. No proxy test promotes
accounting validity, forecasts, production readiness or human acceptance.
